mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use LRU (least recently used) eviction with a 300-second TTL. The stated reason is that LRU is easier to reason about and tune.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/cache-eviction.md`. It says the current recorded decision is LRU eviction with a 300-second TTL, chosen because it is easier to reason about and tune.

That decision is the only cache-eviction one on record that is still active. An earlier note favoring LFU is marked as replaced or revoked, so I left it out.

I couldn't run `muninn export` because it needed approval, so I couldn't view the full record list. I relied on `muninn why` and `muninn show` instead.

Muninn also reports a RED heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout, and I did not investigate it.
